nvEncodeAPI.h: NVENC API 11.1 header from FFmpeg nv-codec-headers, tag n11.1.5.3
(https://github.com/FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers). MIT-style licence from NVIDIA, see the
header's own copyright notice. Matches the API version driver_vrlink uses (0x7101000b
lock / 0xf101000b reconfigure struct versions).
